_source: Web-sourced 2026-09-23; South OC + coastal/central OC gap cities. Verify each against sourceUrl before publishing.

sites.name: Laguna Food Pantry
sites.address: 20652 Laguna Canyon Road, Unit B, Laguna Beach, CA 92651
sites.scheduleText: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.
sites.eligibility: None. Groceries 100% free; ID requested, residency not required. Once weekly.

sites.name: Mariners Church Food Pantry
sites.scheduleText: Tuesday through Friday, 9:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.
sites.eligibility: Orange County residents; call before visiting. Choice-based.

sites.name: City of Irvine Free Grocery Food Box
sites.scheduleText: Second Thursday of each month, 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Drive-through, first-come first-served (Great Park, Parking Lot 2).
sites.eligibility: ~30-lb box of food once a month

sites.name: South County Outreach Food Market
sites.scheduleText: Monday through Thursday, 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. By appointment; email appointments@sco-oc.org or call. Once a month.
sites.eligibility: Application, income self-declaration, and photo ID required. Appointment required.

sites.name: Nourishing Great Futures Market (Boys & Girls Clubs of Capistrano Valley)
sites.scheduleText: Every Wednesday, 9:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Rain or shine. Walk-ups welcome; first come, first served.
sites.eligibility: None. No ID or proof of income; provide last name and family size. Bring bags.

sites.name: Coast Hills Church Food Pantry
sites.scheduleText: 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month, 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM.
sites.eligibility: Families in the church and community

sites.name: Crossline Community Church Food Pantry
sites.scheduleText: Wednesday and Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.

sites.name: Mission Hills Church Food Pantry
sites.scheduleText: Tuesday 3:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. and Wednesday 5:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. (community meal Wed).
sites.eligibility: Client-choice pantry for those with food insecurity or emergency need

sites.name: St. Kilian Outreach Food Pantry
sites.scheduleText: Tuesdays 10:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. and Fridays 9:00 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.

sites.name: RSM Cares Food Pantry
sites.address: 30605 Avenida de Las Flores, Rancho Santa Margarita, CA 92688
sites.scheduleText: 1st and 3rd Wednesday of each month, 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM. Drive-through.

sites.name: Dana Point Senior Center Food Pantry
sites.address: 34052 Del Obispo Street, Dana Point, CA 92629
sites.scheduleText: 3rd Thursday of the month, 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

sites.name: St. Michael's Society Food Pantry (Saint Michael's Church)
sites.scheduleText: Monday, 4:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. Please do not arrive before 3:30 p.m.
sites.eligibility: Bring photo ID and proof of address

sites.name: Melinda Hoag Smith Center for Healthy Living Food Distribution
sites.scheduleText: 1st and 3rd Thursday of every month (drive-thru). Call for the day's start time; allotment by family size; once per month per registrant. Dates shift for holidays.

sites.name: Beachcities Pantry (Beachcities Church)
sites.scheduleText: Typically 1st and 3rd Saturday, curbside 8:00-9:30 a.m. by appointment. Online order form opens Sun 8 a.m., closes Tue 8 p.m. or at capacity. Photo ID; one order per household.
sites.eligibility: Community members with basic food/household needs; photo ID; online order required.

sites.name: St. Bonaventure Catholic Parish - HOPE Food Ministry
sites.scheduleText: Monday through Friday, 10:00 a.m. to 11:15 a.m.
sites.eligibility: Seniors and families near Huntington Beach

sites.name: Oak View Family Resource Center Food Distribution
sites.scheduleText: Every Friday, 9:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Call after 11 a.m. Monday with name and phone; you are assigned a slot for the following Friday.
sites.eligibility: Anyone in need. Advance sign-up required.

sites.name: First Christian Church of Huntington Beach Drive-Thru Pantry
sites.scheduleText: 4th Sunday of every month, 1:00 PM to 2:30 PM. Drive-thru (corner of Adams & 17th).

sites.name: Community United Methodist Church Food Closet
sites.scheduleText: Fridays, 12:00 p.m. to 2:00 p.m. One bag of essentials plus extras, once a month.
sites.eligibility: HB and Westminster individuals/families in need (once monthly)

sites.name: Vietnamese American Cancer Foundation (VACF) Food Distribution
sites.address: 17150 Newhope St, Suite 201-203, Fountain Valley, CA 92708
sites.scheduleText: First Saturday of each month, 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM.

sites.name: Caring Kitchen (Costa Mesa Church of Christ)
sites.address: 287 W Wilson St, Costa Mesa, CA 92627
sites.scheduleText: Hot meals every Tuesday evening, 5:30 p.m. to 6:30 p.m.

sites.name: Armor of Light Ministry Food Pantry (Calvary Chapel)
sites.scheduleText: Sunday, 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.
